incoming.name: Glasgow
incoming.excerpt: Nesbitt and Still Game capture the humour of the Glaswegian patois, while Billy Connolly has made Glaswegian humour known to the rest of the world.

outgoing.name: Fiction

outgoing.name: Glasgow
